user.title: New template media player
user.description: Just the basics. When it's created, press the gear / Configure button on the integration to set up its state, details and buttons. Everything is point-and-click, no templates needed.

data_description.base_media_player_entity_id: Optional. Anything you don't set up yourself is copied from, or passed on to, this player.

error.invalid_template: That template has a syntax error.
error.invalid_actions: Those actions aren't valid. Check the YAML.
error.invalid_object: This must be a YAML dictionary (key: value).

init.title: Template Media Player
init.description:
Pick what you want to set up. Everything saves as you go. Choose **Save & close** when you're finished.

{summary}

menu_options.general: Basics: name look, base player, media browser
menu_options.availability: Availability: when it shows as unavailable
menu_options.attributes_media: What's playing: title, artist, artwork, duration...
menu_options.attributes_player: Player info: volume, muted, source, shuffle, repeat
menu_options.actions_playback: Buttons: play, pause, stop, next, previous, seek
menu_options.actions_other: Buttons: repeat, shuffle, play media, grouping

data_description.base_media_player_entity_id: Anything you don't set up yourself (state, info, buttons) is copied from, or passed on to, this player.
data_description.browse_media_entity_id: Borrow another player's media browser. Uses the base player if empty.
data_description.search_media_entity_id: Borrow another player's media search. Uses the base player if empty.

attributes_media.title: What's playing
attributes_media.description: Pick one to set it up. A ✓ means it's already set.

attributes_player.title: Player info
attributes_player.description: Pick one to set it up. A ✓ means it's already set.

actions_playback.title: Playback buttons
actions_playback.description: Pick one to set it up. A ✓ means it's already set. You'll choose what happens when it's pressed.

actions_power.title: Power and volume buttons
actions_power.description: Pick one to set it up. A ✓ means it's already set. You'll choose what happens when it's pressed.

actions_other.title: Other buttons
actions_other.description: Pick one to set it up. A ✓ means it's already set. You'll choose what happens when it's pressed.

value_entity.title: {label}: pick an entity
value_entity.description: Choose the entity to read from.

data_description.scale_100: Turn this on if the entity reports volume as a percentage.

value_attribute.title: {label}: pick an attribute
value_attribute.description: Which attribute of {entity} should be used? Pick from the list, or type one.

data_description.scale_100: Turn this on if the entity reports volume as a percentage.

value_states.title: {label}: which states?
value_states.description: Choose every state of {entity} that counts as yes. Pick from the list or type your own and press Enter.

value_state_map.title: State: match up the states
value_state_map.description: For each player state, choose which states of {entity} mean it. Leave blank the ones you don't need. Pick from the list or type your own and press Enter.

data.fallback: If nothing above matches, show as

value_fixed.title: {label}: fixed value
value_fixed.description: This text will always be used.

value_custom.title: {label}: template
value_custom.description: Advanced. Write a template that gives the value.

custom_attrs.title: Extra attributes
custom_attrs.description: Add anything you like to the player as an extra attribute. You have {count} so far.

custom_attr_add.title: Add or change an attribute
custom_attr_add.description: Give it a name, or pick an existing one to change it. Next you'll choose where its value comes from.

menu_options.action_replace: Start over with a new action

action_type.title: {label}: what should happen?
action_type.description:
Choose what this does when it's used.

Values you can use: {vars}

action_forward.title: {label}: pass it on
action_forward.description: The other player will do the same thing, using the value it's given.

data_description.target_name: Optional. Only needed if that player calls it something different.

action_call_entity.title: {label}: control a device
action_call_entity.description: Which device or entity should be controlled?

action_call_service.title: {label}: what should it do?
action_call_service.description: What should happen to {entity}? Pick from the list, or type any service name.

data_description.scale_100: Turn this on if the device expects a volume from 0 to 100.

action_wait.title: {label}: wait
action_wait.description: Pause before the next step runs.

action_yaml.title: {label}: actions
action_yaml.description: Advanced. Build the actions in the editor, or switch it to YAML mode. Values you can use: {vars}

action_more.title: {label}: saved
action_more.description:
Saved. This is what it does now:

{current}

menu_options.action_type: Add another step (for example, also turn on a second device)

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Each source is a name, plus what happens when someone picks it. You have {count} so far.

sources_edit.title: Add or change a source
sources_edit.description: Pick a source from the list (names from the base player are suggested, and ✓ marks ones you've set up), or type a new name.

sound_modes.title: Sound modes
sound_modes.description: Each sound mode is a name, plus what happens when someone picks it. You have {count} so far.

menu_options.sound_modes_edit: Add or change a sound mode

sound_modes_edit.title: Add or change a sound mode
sound_modes_edit.description: Pick a sound mode from the list (names from the base player are suggested, and ✓ marks ones you've set up), or type a new name.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: For power users: write templates and YAML directly. Anything set here shows up in the simple menus too.

data_description.state: Must give one of: on, off, idle, playing, paused, standby, buffering.
data_description.availability: False, off, none or unavailable makes the player show as unavailable.
data_description.global_template: Added in front of every template, re-checked each update. Good for set lines.
data_description.variables: A YAML dictionary. Values are templates worked out once at startup and usable in every template.

adv_attributes_media.title: Advanced: what's playing
adv_attributes_media.description: Templates. Leave empty to copy from the base player (if you set one).

data_description.media_position_updated_at: When the position was measured. Filled in automatically if you only give a position.
data_description.media_content_rating: Shows up as a plain extra attribute.
data_description.media_summary: Shows up as a plain extra attribute.

adv_attributes_player.title: Advanced: player info
adv_attributes_player.description: Templates. Leave empty to copy from the base player (if you set one).

data_description.group_members: A list of entity IDs, or a comma separated list.

adv_custom_attributes.title: Advanced: extra attributes
adv_custom_attributes.description: A YAML dictionary of name: template.

adv_services_playback.title: Advanced: playback buttons
adv_services_playback.description: Actions that run when each button is pressed. Leave empty to use the base player (or nothing).

adv_services_power.title: Advanced: power and volume buttons
adv_services_power.description: Actions that run when each button is pressed.

adv_services_other.title: Advanced: other buttons
adv_services_other.description: Actions that run when each button is pressed.
